original_title: Antibody-drug conjugate engineering: from design to efficacy and safety
title: Trying to make ADC design less trial-and-error
blurb: A review on antibody-drug conjugates, where getting one to work means juggling antigen choice, antibody engineering, linker chemistry, and payload pharmacology all at once, which is exactly what makes pure empirical tinkering slow. The pitch here is AI and computational biophysics stepping in to speed that up. Survey piece, no new conjugate of its own.

original_title: Antibody-drug conjugate engineering: from design to efficacy and safety.
title: The ADC design-to-clinic review, in Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy
blurb: Same territory: antibody-drug conjugate engineering walked from design choices through to efficacy and safety. No data of its own to report here, just where it landed.

original_title: A Study to Learn How Safe the Study Treatment Actinium-225-macropa-pelgifatamab (BAY3546828) is, How it Affects the Body, How it Moves Into, Through and Out of the Body, and About Its Anticancer Activity in Participants With Advanced Metastatic Castration-resistant Prostate Cancer (mCRPC)
title: Bayer's actinium-225 conjugate is in prostate cancer patients now
blurb: Phase 1 trial of BAY3546828, an actinium-225-macropa-pelgifatamab construct, in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer. Standard first-in-human remit: safety, how it moves through the body, and a look at anticancer activity along the way. No longer recruiting, so this cohort's locked and it's a wait for readout.

original_title: A Multiscale Quantitative Systems Pharmacology Platform for Early Screening of MMAE-Based Antibody-Drug Conjugates.
title: Modeling MMAE-based ADCs before anyone builds them
blurb: A multiscale quantitative systems pharmacology platform aimed at screening MMAE-payload antibody-drug conjugates computationally early, before committing to synthesis and animal work.

original_title: Cysteine/GSH-Responsive Lipid Switch Development for Liposome Triggered Cargo Release
title: A liposome that only pops open inside cancer cells
blurb: A lipid switch tuned to cysteine and glutathione, both of which cancer cells keep abundant to fend off oxidative stress, so cargo release triggers off that redox signature rather than leaking out passively. Targeted release keyed to something tumors already overproduce.

original_title: Development of Novel 211At-Labeled Agent for Neurotensin Receptor 1-Targeted α-Particle Therapy
title: Building toward an astatine-211 warhead for neurotensin receptor 1
blurb: NTSR1 is overexpressed across several cancer types, and this group is working toward an 211At-labeled alpha-particle therapy agent against it. For now they've built and tested iodine-125 surrogate versions, IB-NTS, IB-DOTA-NTS, and IB-In-DOTA-NTS, for plasma stability and receptor binding, which is the standard warm-up before touching the actual alpha emitter.

original_title: Design, Synthesis, and Biological Evaluation of a Novel Gedatolisib−Phospholipid Conjugate and Liposomal Formulations Based Thereon
title: A PI3K/mTOR inhibitor that only wakes up once it reaches the tumor
blurb: A phospholipid prodrug of gedatolisib built to be cut loose by phospholipase A2, so the liposome stays quiet until it's in the right lipid environment. That quieting is real: cytotoxicity drops 2-3 orders of magnitude versus free drug in cell lines. They followed it with in vivo testing in the EMT6 breast cancer model.

original_title: Gallium Complexes of Tetradentate Formazanate Ligands: Synthesis, Property Benchmarking, and Radiolabeling
title: Giving formazanate dyes a gallium core instead of boron
blurb: Formazanate ligand complexes are usually built around boron, but this makes six-coordinate gallium versions instead, benchmarks their optoelectronic and redox behavior against different axial ligands (water, DMAP, DMSO, acetate), and tests radiolabeling. An underexplored corner of the ligand class, and the radiolabeling angle is the tell that imaging is the actual endgame.

original_title: Comparative Dosimetry of Single and Hybrid (177)Lu, (161)Tb, and (90)Y in PSMA-Targeted Therapy.
title: Sizing up lutetium-177, terbium-161, and yttrium-90 for PSMA therapy, solo and mixed
blurb: A comparative dosimetry study running Lu-177, Tb-161, and Y-90 both alone and in hybrid combinations for PSMA-targeted therapy, working out how the dose distributions stack up against each other.

original_title: Size-dependent effect of site-specific polyethylene glycol modification of trastuzumab on the antibody functions
title: Trastuzumab PEGylation: where and how big changes the antibody
blurb: Site-specific PEGylation of trastuzumab, testing whether the size of the PEG chain and exactly where it sits change antigen-binding and Fc-receptor activity far from the attachment site itself. That distal effect is the part nobody's pinned down carefully before.

original_title: Click chemistry-modified cardiomyocytes enhance cardiac contractility and prevent remodeling in ischemia-reperfusion injured hearts.
title: Click-modified cardiomyocytes hold up heart function after ischemia-reperfusion
blurb: Cardiomyocytes modified via click chemistry that boost contractility and blunt remodeling in ischemia-reperfusion injured hearts.

original_title: Optimizing the Therapeutic Index: Sequential Intraarterial–Intravenous PRRT with Personalized Volumetric-Adjusted Dosing
title: PRRT split into an intraarterial dose then a calibrated IV top-up
blurb: Sequential intraarterial-then-intravenous PRRT with dosing calibrated to each patient's volumes, aimed at widening the therapeutic index rather than just cranking up total activity.

original_title: Concise Total Syntheses of (−)-Ohioensin A, Putative (+)-Ohioensin C, (+)-Myristinins A and B/C, and (+)-Caesalpinflavan A
title: One route, five natural products, ohioensins included
blurb: A single enantioselective route reaches the first total syntheses of (−)-ohioensin A, putative (+)-ohioensin C, myristinins A and B/C, and caesalpinflavan A, all built around a new chiral biphenol-catalyzed conjugate addition of boronic acids. That "putative" tag on ohioensin C is the tell, this synthesis is probably also a structure check.
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society

original_title: Next-Generation Peptide Receptor Radionuclide Therapy: A Phase 1 Dose-Escalation and Dosimetry Study of (177)Lu-DOTA-EB-TATE.
title: Dose-escalation and dosimetry for next-gen PRRT agent Lu-177-DOTA-EB-TATE
blurb: Phase 1 dose-escalation and dosimetry for Lu-177-DOTA-EB-TATE, billed as next-generation PRRT. Still just the dosing groundwork, no efficacy readout yet.

original_title: A SPAAC-Based Bioorthogonal Method for Verifying Protein Palmitoylation.
title: A click-chemistry check for whether a protein actually got palmitoylated
blurb: A step-by-step Bio-protocol laying out a SPAAC-based bioorthogonal method to verify protein palmitoylation. A lab technique, not a finding.

original_title: The Scm FCS finger binds the Pcl Tudor domain to link canonical PRC1 and PRC2.1 in Drosophila
title: How Drosophila's two Polycomb complexes actually grab each other
blurb: Pulling intact canonical PRC1 out of cryo-milled Drosophila embryos together with the full PRC2.1 complex, no chemical crosslinking needed this time, then using AlphaFold3 to map the interface: the Scm FCS finger binds the Pcl Tudor domain. Gives a real structural handle on an association that was previously only inferred from crosslinked pulldowns.

original_title: Renal Function Decline After (177)Lu-PSMA-617 Versus Taxane-Based Chemotherapy in Patients with Metastatic Castration-Resistant Prostate Cancer: A Propensity Score Analysis.
title: Lu-177-PSMA-617 vs taxane chemo: which one spares the kidneys
blurb: A propensity-score analysis comparing renal function decline after Lu-177-PSMA-617 versus taxane-based chemotherapy in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer. Retrospective comparison, so it's an association, not a trial.

original_title: A self-crosslinkable, adhesive intestine-derived extracellular matrix hydrogel enhances organoid retention and restores intestinal barrier integrity.
title: A self-crosslinking gut-ECM hydrogel that keeps organoids put
blurb: An intestine-derived ECM hydrogel that crosslinks itself, sticky enough to improve organoid retention and restore intestinal barrier integrity.

original_title: Trastuzumab Rezetecan Improves Progression-Free Survival in Chemotherapy-Refractory HER2-Positive Advanced Colorectal Cancer - ascopost.com
title: Trastuzumab rezetecan keeps working once chemo stops, in HER2-positive colorectal cancer
blurb: Trastuzumab rezetecan posts a progression-free survival improvement in chemotherapy-refractory HER2-positive advanced colorectal cancer. Another antibody-drug conjugate finding a niche after standard treatment craps out.

original_title: Phase 1 Dose-Escalation Study of the Rapid-Clearance Radioligand [(177)Lu]Lu-P17-087 in Metastatic Castration-Resistant Prostate Cancer: Dosimetry, Safety, and Preliminary Efficacy.
title: A faster-clearing Lu-177 ligand takes its first human lap
blurb: Phase 1 dose escalation of [177Lu]Lu-P17-087 in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer, built specifically for rapid clearance, with dosimetry, safety, and preliminary efficacy reported. Early days, so the efficacy numbers are a first look, not a verdict.

original_title: Phase 1 Dose-Escalation Study of the Rapid-Clearance Radioligand [ 177 Lu]Lu-P17-087 in Metastatic Castration-Resistant Prostate Cancer: Dosimetry, Safety, and Preliminary Efficacy
title: P17-087: a Lu-177 prostate ligand designed to clear out fast
blurb: First-in-human dose escalation for [177Lu]Lu-P17-087 in mCRPC, pitched on rapid clearance, presumably to spare normal organs the dose the slower Lu-PSMA agents rack up. Dosimetry, safety, and preliminary efficacy are in, the durability question waits for the next trial.

original_title: Electroreductive oxime carboxylation with CO<sub>2</sub> produces arylglycines
title: Arylglycines made without touching cyanide
blurb: A two-step electrochemical route builds arylglycines straight from aldehydes, nitrite, and CO2, with CO2 itself doing the carboxylation instead of cyanide, harsh reagents, or a biocatalyst. A cleaner path to a class of amino acids that usually means messier chemistry.

original_title: Implications of the Latest Expanded Label of 177 Lu-PSMA-617 for Nuclear Medicine Practice
title: What the newest Lu-PSMA-617 label expansion actually changes in the clinic
blurb: A practical rundown of what the latest expanded label for 177Lu-PSMA-617 means for how nuclear medicine actually uses it day to day, guidance rather than new trial data.

original_title: Multivalent SO4-3-Galactose Glycopolymers Define a Structural Threshold for CD206 Endocytic Inhibition
title: How many sugars it takes to jam the mannose receptor shut
blurb: Follow-up to their own earlier finding that SO4-3-Gal glycopolymers block CD206 recycling to the cell surface: testing a valency ladder from 6.5 to 211, made via a new scalable synthesis, to find where the multivalent effect actually kicks in. CD206 has been a target everyone wanted and nobody had good modulators for, so a hard valency threshold is more useful than it sounds.

original_title: Bioinspired Injectable Thermosensitive Gallic Acid-Conjugated Hyaluronic Acid/Pluronic Hydrogels to Prevent Postoperative Adhesion.
title: An injectable gel meant to stop organs sticking together after surgery
blurb: A thermosensitive hydrogel of gallic acid-conjugated hyaluronic acid and Pluronic, designed to gel at body temperature in place and act as a physical barrier against postoperative adhesion.

original_title: Mass-spectrometry Based Structural Proteomics in Characterizing Protein Higher Order Structure-Development and Applications in Neurodegeneration, Cancer, and Infectious Disease
title: A tour of what mass spec can tell you about protein shape
blurb: A review of mass-spectrometry-based structural proteomics for probing protein higher-order structure, the folding, assembly, and conformational shuffling static structures don't capture, with applications spanning neurodegeneration, cancer, and infectious disease. A methods review, not new data of its own.
venue: Open Scholarship Institutional Repository (Washington University in St. Louis)

original_title: Imaging the Cancer Metabolome
title: Picturing the cancer metabolome
blurb: A review of nuclear medicine approaches aimed at imaging cancer's metabolic profile directly rather than just its anatomy.

original_title: Glypican-3 as a Theranostic Target in Hepatocellular Carcinoma
title: Glypican-3: a theranostic handle for liver cancer
blurb: A look at GPC3 as a target for pairing imaging and therapy in hepatocellular carcinoma, the same theranostic playbook PSMA popularized, aimed at a cancer that badly needs one.

original_title: Engineering Hybrid Peptides and Ionic Liquid-Peptide Conjugates for a Fast Action on Bacterial Membranes
title: An anti-aging cosmetic peptide gets drafted as an antibiotic scaffold
blurb: PP4, a peptide normally sold for skin anti-aging, gets fused to the antimicrobial peptide 3.1 in two hybrid orientations, and in a third version 3.1 is swapped out for an antimicrobial ionic liquid to make the conjugate C16-Im-PP4. All three hit bacterial membranes fast in the paper's own biophysical and microscopy assays, with chronic wound care as the target use.

original_title: Embracing triplet nitrenes for C-to-N replacement of complex bicyclic (hetero)aryl azides
title: Swapping a ring carbon for nitrogen via triplet nitrenes
blurb: C-to-N replacement on complex bicyclic (hetero)aryl azides, run through triplet nitrene intermediates. Skeletal editing on scaffolds that usually sit outside the reach of that kind of surgery.

original_title: Breaking N-alkyl aziridines for cross-coupling reactions
title: Boron finally gets N-alkyl aziridines to ring-open
blurb: N-alkyl aziridines have dodged catalytic ring-opening because every existing trick needs an electron-withdrawing group parked on nitrogen to activate them. Simple borane coordination triggers radical fragmentation instead, no activating group required, opening a general route to β-functionalized amines.

original_title: A Concave Corneal Stromal Scaffold Based on Multi-Crosslinked GelMA Hydrogel for Delaying Keratoconus Progression and Improving corneal morphology.
title: A concave hydrogel scaffold aimed at stalling keratoconus
blurb: A multi-crosslinked GelMA hydrogel built into a concave corneal stromal scaffold, meant to sit in the cornea, slow keratoconus progression, and nudge its shape back toward normal.

original_title: Universal Model for Atoms (UMA) in Computational Asymmetric Catalysis: Comparing Enantioselectivity Predictions
title: Testing whether a general atomic foundation model can call your enantiomer
blurb: UMA predicts enantioselectivity by directly modeling diastereomeric transition states, averaged over conformational ensembles, across two organocatalytic and two metal-catalyzed reactions. It lands within 1-2 kcal/mol of experiment and points to the structural features actually driving stereoinduction, a cheap stand-in for full quantum chemistry, with limitations the authors don't hide.

original_title: Double Boron-Deleting Annulation: Modular Access to Chiral Nonalternant B,N-Helicenes with Enhanced Chiroptical Properties
title: Deleting borons twice to build chiral B,N-helicenes
blurb: A double boron-deleting annulation turns quadruple-borylated precursors, assembled by C-N coupling and borylation, into nonalternant B,N-embedded helicenes with diaza-pentagon-heptagon pairs baked into the cove edges. Twelve examples, and the chiroptical properties beat out the flat precursors they started from.
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society

original_title: Telix (TLX) to Buy Germany’s ITM for up to $2.35 Billion to Lock in its Cancer Isotope Supply - Yahoo Finance
title: Telix buys its own isotope supply chain for $2.35B
blurb: Telix is acquiring Germany's ITM for up to $2.35 billion, a move squarely about locking down its own cancer isotope supply instead of depending on someone else's reactor.

original_title: Total Synthesis and Structure Determination of Mutanolins Detected in a Human Oral Microbiome Symbiont
title: Finally nailing down what mutanolins actually look like
blurb: Mutanolins are macrocyclic lipopeptides that Streptococcus mutans, the cavity bug, makes in the human mouth, and until now their structures were only guessed at from MS/MS on bacterial extracts, with no configuration ever pinned down. Total synthesis of the shared lipidated γ-amino acid core, β-S-linked cysteine included, finally settles the stereochemistry spectroscopically instead of by inference.
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society

original_title: Glypican-3 as a Theranostic Target in Hepatocellular Carcinoma.
title: Glypican-3 as a matched track-and-treat target in liver cancer
blurb: A look at glypican-3 as a theranostic target in hepatocellular carcinoma, using the same target to both image and treat the tumor.

original_title: Rheology-guided experimental design of dynamically crosslinked keratin/ι-carrageenan hydrogels as potential drug delivery systems.
title: Rheology as the design compass for a keratin/carrageenan hydrogel
blurb: Keratin and ι-carrageenan cross-linked into a dynamic hydrogel, with rheology measurements steering the formulation toward use as a drug delivery vehicle.

original_title: aaRSID, an engineered pyrrolysyl-tRNA synthetase platform for multi-probe proximity proteomics
title: A pyrrolysyl-tRNA synthetase platform that gives proximity labeling more than one probe
blurb: TurboID and APEX2 are stuck with whatever reactive chemistry their fixed substrate allows, which means background noise and cells that don't love being tagged. aaRSID engineers the pyrrolysyl-tRNA synthetase itself to run multiple different labeling probes, aimed at proximity proteomics without those same tradeoffs.

original_title: Oxidation-State-Modulated Cobalt Catalysts for Ambient Selective Hydrogenation of Bio-Derived Aldehydes: Toward Bio-Based Polyesters
title: Tuning cobalt's oxidation state to hydrogenate HMF cleanly
blurb: N-doped carbon-supported cobalt from ZIF-67, with the oxidative pretreatment temperature dialed in as the control knob on catalytic activity. The best variant, CoNC200, hits 93% conversion of HMF to BHMF, the monomer that feeds straight into a bio-based polyester (PFAd). A fairly simple lever, oxidation state, for a catalyst that's otherwise just cobalt on carbon.

original_title: Chemoselective Intermolecular Cross-Benzoin Reactions Via Pyridinium-Zwitterion Intermediates
title: Trapping the hydroxycarbene before it tunnels away
blurb: Cross-benzoin reactions have long been stuck on narrow scope and messy byproducts. Here the trick is generating hydroxycarbenes and catching them as pyridinium-zwitterion intermediates before they do their usual quantum-mechanical [1,2]H tunneling shift into the corresponding aldehyde. A genuinely new way into an old reaction, built on intercepting something that normally happens too fast to intercept.
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society

original_title: Electrosynthesis of arylglycines from carbon dioxide, nitrite and aldehydes
title: Building amino acids out of CO2 and oximes, electrochemically
blurb: An electrochemical reduction couples oximes with CO2 to make arylglycines directly, drawing on feedstocks sourced from inorganic waste and biomass instead of the usual petrochemical starting materials. Clean route to a useful amino acid class, run off electricity rather than stoichiometric reagents.

original_title: Identification of Novel Acylthiourea-Based PROTACs Exhibiting Broad-Spectrum Antiviral Activity against Enteroviruses
title: A PROTAC that degrades the enterovirus polymerase instead of just blocking it
blurb: Enteroviruses cause hand, foot and mouth disease, and their serotype diversity has kept broad-spectrum antivirals out of reach. This acylthiourea PROTAC series' lead compound, X14, binds EV71's 3D polymerase with higher affinity than ribavirin and tags it for proteasomal degradation rather than just inhibiting it, with strong activity against EV71 replication. Still one serotype deep before 'broad-spectrum' is really earned.

original_title: Metabolism-Driven Morphomechanical Transitions in a Steady-Dynamic Covalent Double Network Living Hydrogel.
title: A living hydrogel that changes shape as it metabolizes
blurb: A covalent double-network hydrogel built around a living component, where its own metabolism drives shifts between steady and dynamic mechanical states, changing the material's shape and stiffness as it goes. Thin on specifics beyond that, but a material remodeling itself off its own metabolism is the interesting part.

original_title: Sodium Tetrathionate-Promoted Trisulfurative Annulation of 1,3-Diyne Diols toward Dithieno[3,2-b:2′,3′- d ]thiophenes
title: Sodium tetrathionate as a sulfur radical source, apparently a first
blurb: A trisulfurative annulation turns 1,3-diyne diols into dithienothiophenes in one pot, pairing dehydration with the formation of six C–S bonds. The authors say it's the first use of sodium tetrathionate as a sulfur-centered radical precursor for this kind of thioannulation, and it runs to moderate-to-good yields.

original_title: Controlled Epoxide-Enabled Formal Oxygen Insertion of Indenones to Isocoumarins
title: Skipping Baeyer-Villiger's migratory-aptitude problem to get isocoumarins
blurb: Oxygen insertion into indenone carbonyls usually runs through Baeyer-Villiger oxidation, which lives or dies on migratory aptitude for regioselectivity. This borrows an aziridine nitrogen-insertion trick and swaps in an epoxide: H2O2/NaOH epoxidation, then a MeSO3H-promoted rearrangement, landing on isocoumarins as single regioisomers while dodging the usual overoxidation and incomplete conversion.

original_title: Enantioselective C–H Activations by Metallaelectro-Catalysis
title: Electrifying enantioselective C–H activation
blurb: A conspectus making the case for molecular electrocatalysis as the sustainable route into C–H activation, oxidative functionalization run off electrons instead of stoichiometric oxidants, now pushed toward doing it enantioselectively. More survey of a growing platform than a single result, but electrocatalysis creeping into asymmetric C–H chemistry is the thing to track here.

original_title: Multiplicative Stereocontrol in the Light-Driven Deracemization of Benzylic Nitriles
title: Working out where the enantioselectivity actually comes from in light-driven deracemization
blurb: Deracemization by light usually leans on one chiral catalyst to both cleave and re-form a C–H bond at the stereocenter, but separating out how much each step contributes to the final ee has been hard to pin down. This benzylic nitrile system, cooperative photoredox plus chiral phosphate catalysis, reaches up to 99% yield and 98% ee and offers a way to quantify each step's share of the overall selectivity rather than just reporting the final number.
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society

original_title: Tumor-associated calcium signal transducer 2 expression as a promising therapeutic target in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma: a combined the Cancer Genome Atlas and an institutional cohort
title: Checking whether TROP2 is actually worth targeting in esophageal cancer
blurb: TROP2-directed ADCs already work in other tumor types, but its relevance in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma hadn't been pinned down. This combines TCGA data with an institutional IHC cohort to look at TROP2 expression and its prognostic significance in ESCC, building the case for it as an ADC target there. Descriptive groundwork, not a trial.

original_title: Divergent ring opening and functionalization of N-alkyl aziridines via boryl radical fragmentation
title: Boryl radicals crack open unactivated aziridines
blurb: Aziridine-ligated boryl radicals force open N-alkyl aziridines that have resisted direct functionalization until now, and branch into different products depending on conditions, turning a stubborn substrate into a shortcut to varied β-functionalized amines.

original_title: ( N -Hydroxy)amide-Mediated Rapid Head-to-Tail Cyclization of Unprotected Peptides in Water
title: Closing peptides head-to-tail without the protecting-group dance
blurb: Head-to-tail cyclization is entropically unfavorable, so this runs unprotected aminoacyl (N-hydroxy)peptide hydrazides through nitrite oxidation to an azide intermediate that snaps shut fast, in water, across a range of lengths and sequences.
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society

original_title: 2,2,6,6‐Tetramethylpiperidin‐1‐oxyl‐Regulated Divergent 1,5‐ and 1,2‐Hydrogen Atom Transfer for Site‐Selective C(sp 3 )─H Aminations in Continuous Flow
title: One photocatalyst, two different diamine products on demand
blurb: A transition-metal-free, visible-light HAT system that steers 1,5- versus 1,2-hydrogen transfer from the same N-O precursors to give either δ-diamines or α-gem-diamines. Running it in flow also dodges the light-penetration bottleneck that usually throttles these photoreactions, with sub-40-minute residence times.

original_title: A Platinum(IV)-Ursolic Acid Conjugate Overcomes Cisplatin Resistance in Ovarian Cancer by Targeting XPO1 and PARP1
title: A platinum-ursolic acid hybrid that routes around cisplatin resistance
blurb: Bolting ursolic acid onto a Pt(IV) prodrug boosts platinum uptake and DNA platination in cisplatin-resistant ovarian cancer cells, drives S/G2-M arrest and apoptosis, and cuts migration and colony formation, with chemoproteomics pointing to XPO1 and PARP1 as the targets. Still cultured cells, nobody's dosed an animal yet.

original_title: Multi-Response Optimisation of Gas Chromatographic Method for Residual Solvent Quantification in Sitagliptin API via DoE
title: Dialing in a GC method for sitagliptin's residual solvents
blurb: A design-of-experiments pass at optimizing gas chromatography for quantifying residual solvents in sitagliptin API, tuning multiple responses at once instead of one variable at a time.
venue: International Journal of Drug Delivery Technology

original_title: Robust Chemometric Machine Learning Framework for Screening-Stage Triage in Antidoping Urine Analysis
title: Benchmarking 10,920 ML pipelines just to triage doping urine samples
blurb: A chemometric ML framework built on GC-MS/MS peak-area values, 148 analytes across 684 real urine cases, rather than raw chromatograms. They tested nearly 11,000 pipeline combinations before settling on a stacked ensemble for screening-stage triage, the unglamorous infrastructure work antidoping labs actually need to keep up with throughput.

original_title: Design, Synthesis, and Biological Evaluation of Novel MCR-1 Inhibitors against Colistin-Resistant Bacteria
title: A benzopyran that disarms MCR-1 and rescues colistin
blurb: A benzopyran series targeting MCR-1, the enzyme that strips colistin of its last-resort usefulness against multidrug-resistant Gram-negatives. Lead compound 65 restores colistin susceptibility in clinical mcr-1-positive E. coli at 14-fold better potency than the starting hit, with binding studies backing up the mechanism.

original_title: Oxidative ArylSF4-tetrafluoroethylation to N-hydroxydicarboximides via in situ generated Silver intermediate from silver(I) fluoride.
title: A silver shortcut to Aryl-SF4 tetrafluoroethylation
blurb: Generates a silver-SF4Aryl-tetrafluoroethyl species in situ from AgF, then runs it straight into oxidative radical addition onto N-hydroxyimides with NBS as the terminal oxidant. Aryl-SF4 fluoroalkylating reagents are rare enough that just having a clean way to make and use one on the fly is the point.

original_title: Late-Stage Posttranslational Assembly of Fosfazinomycins
title: Fosfazinomycin's missing link turns out to borrow RiPP machinery
blurb: The phosphonate and hydrazine halves of fosfazinomycin are assembled separately, and how they get stitched together had been an open question. The final step recruits enzymatic machinery normally associated with ribosomally synthesized peptides, wiring two supposedly unrelated pathways together.

original_title: Visible-Light-Induced Phosphonium Salt Catalysis for Site-Selective Aromatic C–H Halogenation and Chalcogenation
title: A phosphonium salt catalyst for lighting up aromatic C-H bonds
blurb: Visible light plus an in-situ-generated phosphonium salt, made from ordinary phosphorus catalysts and off-the-shelf halogenating or chalcogenating reagents, delivers site-selective chlorination, bromination, iodination, thiocyanation, selenocyanation, and even trifluoromethylthiolation on arenes and heteroarenes, all without a transition metal.

original_title: Intramolecular (3 + 2) Cycloaddition of Olefins to Aromatic Aldehydes Mediated by Visible Light and a Lewis Acid Catalyst
title: A photocycloaddition that builds cyclopentane rings with visible light
blurb: Benzaldehydes carrying an alkenyloxy arm at the 3-position fold back on themselves under AlBr3 catalysis and 435 nm light, the olefin adding to both the carbonyl carbon and C2 of the ring to close a cyclopentane. Thirty tricyclic products came out at 44-94% yield with high diastereoselectivity on both counts, and transient absorption work suggests the catalyzed and uncatalyzed pathways aren't running through the same mechanism.

original_title: Discovery and Bioinspired Synthesis of Neuroprotective Geranylated Chalcones From Artocarpus communis
title: Bioinspired synthesis nails a pentacyclic chalcone from breadfruit
blurb: Artocarpusones A and B, two geranylated chalcone oligomers with a fused 6/5/6/5/6 pentacyclic hemiketal core, turned up in Artocarpus communis along with six relatives. The team's biosynthetic hunch, that most of these share one precursor, held up well enough to actually guide a synthesis, getting the natural products in 7-9 steps instead of just proposing a pathway on paper.

original_title: Cobalt-Catalyzed Hydrosilylative Deoxygenation of Carboxylic Acids and Esters
title: Cobalt swaps in for palladium on the deoxygenation job
blurb: Co2(CO)8, cheap and shelf-stable, converts aryl and benzylic esters straight to the corresponding alkanes at 120°C in THF within 12 hours, no additives required. That replaces the usual stoichiometric hydride reagents or multistep sequences with one cheap earth-abundant precatalyst, a real upgrade if the selectivity holds outside the reported substrates.

original_title: Total Synthesis of the Cyclodepsipeptide Nodupetide and Evaluation of Its Cytotoxicity
title: Total synthesis puts nodupetide's cytotoxicity to the test
blurb: An Evans aldol sets the tricky stereocenter in nodupetide's HMHA fragment, and classical solution-phase peptide coupling stitches together the rest of the cyclodepsipeptide. Both the finished natural product and its two acyclic precursors showed cytotoxic activity in preliminary testing, so the macrocycle isn't obviously where the activity comes from.

original_title: Photochemical Aldehyde–Olefin Coupling via In Situ Activation of α-Benzoyloxy Chlorides
title: Ketyl radicals from aldehydes without a metal reductant
blurb: Turning an aliphatic aldehyde into a ketyl radical usually means a metal reductant or a precious-metal catalyst. Here the aldehyde is converted in situ to an alpha-benzoyloxy chloride, which a photoexcited Hantzsch ester reduces directly, and the resulting radical couples with an olefin in one pot. Simple to run, broad functional group tolerance, and it works on late-stage bioactive molecules, so no metal tax for the umpolung step.

original_title: Stereoselective Synthesis of ( E )-α-Deuterated α,β-Unsaturated Carboxylic Acids via Silver-Promoted Defluorinative Deuteration of gem -Difluoroallenes
title: Putting a deuterium exactly where the vinylic position needs one
blurb: AgOTf converts gem-difluoroallenes and D2O into (E)-alpha-deuterated unsaturated carboxylic acids, with the D2O supplying both the deuterium and the oxygen through an acyl fluoride intermediate. Up to 98% deuterium incorporation and E/Z selectivity as good as 17:1, on a position that's normally hard to deuterate stereoselectively at all.

original_title: Chemodivergent [4 + 1] and [3 + 2 + 1] Annulations of Dioxazolones with Allenoates: Access to Two Distinct Functionalized Heterocycles
title: One dioxazolone, two heterocycles, just flip the catalyst
blurb: Dioxazolones usually just run a clean Lossen rearrangement, since the intermediates are too unstable to interrupt cleanly. Coupling them with allenoates and switching catalyst and conditions routes to either a [4+1] or a [3+2+1] annulation, DABCO and water steer it to the [4+1] product, so the same two building blocks give access to two distinct heterocycle families depending on which knob gets turned.

original_title: Photochemical Strategies for the Synthesis of C ‐Disubstituted Bicyclo[1.1.1]pentanes via Direct Difunctionalization of [1.1.1]Propellane: A Review
title: A review of every way to double-substitute bicyclo[1.1.1]pentanes
blurb: Bicyclo[1.1.1]pentanes have become a standard bioisostere in drug design, and C-disubstituted variants let you tune both ends of the cage independently. This rounds up the photochemical methods for getting there by difunctionalizing [1.1.1]propellane directly, useful as a reference when picking a method rather than inventing one.

original_title: Green Light‐Driven, Diastereoselective Synthesis of Pentasubstituted α ‐Trifluoromethylated Pyrrolidines via a Singlet Carbene Process
title: Green light builds CF3-pyrrolidines through a singlet carbene
blurb: A three-component reaction of enones, trifluoromethyl diazo compounds, and alkyl nitriles under green light, no metal catalyst involved, runs through a singlet carbene to deliver pentasubstituted alpha-trifluoromethyl pyrrolidines with good diastereoselectivity. Stereoselective access to polysubstituted CF3-pyrrolidines is normally the hard part, so skipping the metal here is the actual win.

original_title: Dual Triplet Ketone/Nickel Catalysis for the Cross-Coupling of Aryl/Alkyl Bromides with Alkyl Boronic Acids/Boronates through Radical Transfer Strategy
title: A triplet ketone hands nickel its radical partner
blurb: Triplet ketone photocatalysis paired with nickel catalysis cross-couples aryl or alkyl bromides with alkyl boronic acids or boronates, using an aminyl radical transfer strategy to build both C(sp3)-C(sp2) and C(sp3)-C(sp3) bonds. Morpholine is pulling double duty in the mechanism, and the whole setup runs on cheap starting materials with broad functional group tolerance, including late-stage substrates.

original_title: Industrial-Scale Electrosynthesis of Amino Acids from the Air via a Molecular Ligand-Engineered Bismuth Catalyst
title: Making glycine out of thin air, electrochemically
blurb: A ligand-engineered bismuth catalyst pulls glycine out of simulated plasma-oxidized air and glyoxylic acid at 93% Faradaic efficiency and 100 mA cm⁻², the kind of current density that actually matters for scaling past a beaker. The one-pot activity-selectivity tradeoff that's wrecked prior attempts at this seems to be the thing they actually solved, in-situ MOF-derived catalyst and all.
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society

original_title: Halogen‐Bond‐Assisted Anti ‐Selective Henry Reaction Promoted by a Chiral Nickel Catalyst
title: Getting the Henry reaction to go anti for once
blurb: Most catalytic asymmetric Henry reactions default to the syn nitroaldol; this chiral nickel catalyst flips it to anti, up to 96:4 dr and 99% ee, by using a halogen bond between the ligand and the aldehyde's aromatic ring to lock in an extended, pseudo-diequatorial conformation. DFT backs the mechanism rather than just the yields.

original_title: Combined Importance of Non-Specific and Specific Interactions on the Cellular Uptake Kinetics of Peptide-Functionalized Mesoporous Silica Nanoparticles Targeting Integrins In Vitro
title: Nanoparticle uptake isn't just about how many targeting peptides you slap on
blurb: Everyone optimizes ligand density on integrin-targeting silica nanoparticles and calls it a day; this one also tracks charge and non-specific binding alongside the specific peptide-integrin interaction, across cell lines with different receptor density. Uptake kinetics depend on both working together, not on peptide density alone.

original_title: Discovery of an HSP90-Modulating Amphiphilic Peptide Dendrimer as a Bioactive Carrier for Combination Cancer Therapy
title: A drug that's also its own delivery vehicle
blurb: An amphiphilic peptide dendrimer that carries drug cargo and does its own cancer-killing, via HSP90, which they pinned down with reverse docking plus limited-proteolysis mass spec rather than just assuming a target. Amphiphilic balance and dendrimer shape both tune the activity, so it's not a one-size scaffold.

original_title: Oxygen-Deletion Skeletal Editing of Oxetanes to Cyclopropanes
title: Deleting an oxygen turns an oxetane into a cyclopropane
blurb: A one-pot sequence, dibrominative ring-opening followed by electroreductive cyclization, strips the oxygen out of readily available oxetanes and closes the ring back up as a cyclopropane. Simple idea nobody had pulled off cleanly before, and the substrate scope looks broad rather than a single lucky case.

original_title: Tunable Sulfenylnitrenes Enable Scaffold Hopping of Furans Into N ‐Heterocycles
title: Swapping a furan's oxygen for nitrogen, without rebuilding the ring
blurb: Tunable sulfenylnitrenes convert furans directly into N-heterocycles like pyrimidines, pyrroles, and pyridazines, a scaffold hop that skips building the ring from scratch. The payoff is the usual one for N-heterocycles: better hydrogen bonding and pharmacokinetics than the furan you started with.

original_title: Developing a Molybdenum(IV) Agent Based on a Specific N-Donor Residue in Human Serum Albumin IB Subdomain: Multi-Targeted Inhibition of Growth and Metastasis in Hepatocellular Carcinoma
title: A molybdenum drug that hitches a ride on serum albumin
blurb: Mo5, a molybdenum(IV) thiosemicarbazone compound, is cytotoxic on its own, but the interesting part is where it sits on human serum albumin: His146 in the IB subdomain literally swaps in for one of Mo5's chloride ligands and coordinates the metal directly. That Mo5-HSA complex beats Mo5 alone against hepatocellular carcinoma growth and metastasis in their hands.

original_title: Visible-Light-Induced Stereoselective Radical 1,3-Iodosulfonylation of Methylenecyclopropanes
title: Cracking open cyclopropanes with light instead of metal
blurb: Visible light drives a strain-release radical cascade on unactivated methylenecyclopropanes, cleaving a C–C bond to deliver alkyl iodide-alkenyl sulfones with real regio- and stereocontrol, no transition metal or heat required. The ring strain does the job usually handed to a catalyst.

original_title: Catalytic enantioselective construction of spiro stereocenters: recent advances and perspectives
title: A review roundup on building spiro stereocenters asymmetrically
blurb: A survey of where catalytic enantioselective routes to spiro stereocenters currently stand and where the field is headed, rather than a new method of its own.

original_title: Mechanistic Insights Into Dirhodium‐Catalyzed Arylation of sp 2 C─H Bond: Reaction Profile, Ligand Effects, and Comparison With Diruthenium Catalysis
title: Why one NHC ligand works and its near-twin doesn't
blurb: DFT on dirhodium/NHC-catalyzed C–H arylation finds a stepwise path, oxidative addition to a Rh(I) center followed by acetate-assisted deprotonation, and traces IPr's failure to a brutal 41.0 kcal/mol C–H activation barrier that IMes simply doesn't have. Swap in the analogous diruthenium catalyst and the mechanism changes outright, not just the rate.

original_title: The recycle reality: A process-level perspective on catalytic CO2 hydrogenation to methanol
title: CO2-to-methanol, minus the lab-bench optimism
blurb: A process-level look at catalytic CO2 hydrogenation to methanol, focused on what recycling unconverted feed actually costs rather than just catalyst turnover numbers.

original_title: Recent Advances in Asymmetric Electrochemical Synthesis
title: Running asymmetric synthesis on electrons instead of reagents
blurb: A review of asymmetric electrosynthesis, using potential and current to steer selectivity instead of stoichiometric reductants or oxidants, generating radicals and radical ions on demand under mild conditions. It's a summary of the field's state, not a single new result.

original_title: Serial Multitracer PET/CT for Characterization of the Inflammation–Fibrosis Axis in Liver Injury
title: Watching liver injury flip from inflammation to fibrosis, tracer by tracer
blurb: Serial PET/CT with multiple tracers used to track the handoff between inflammation and fibrosis during liver injury, in J Nucl Med.

original_title: Electrochemical Transformations of Organosulfurs and Beyond
title: What years of organosulfur electrochemistry adds up to
blurb: A personal account rounding up the authors' own work turning organosulfur compounds into useful targets for synthesis, agrochemicals, and materials, all run through green electrochemical catalysis. A retrospective, not a single new transformation.

original_title: Serial Multitracer PET/CT for Characterization of the Inflammation-Fibrosis Axis in Liver Injury.
title: Same liver, two tracers, watching fibrosis take over
blurb: Multitracer PET/CT used serially to characterize how inflammation gives way to fibrosis in liver injury.

original_title: Programming semiconducting two-dimensional conjugated metal–organic frameworks via anisotropic reticular chemistry
title: Building 2D conjugated MOFs one bond at a time
blurb: A low-symmetry ligand lets metals coordinate site-selectively and in sequence, so both the framework's topology and its bimetallic node arrangement can be dialed in from a single ligand. That got seven distinct single-crystal frameworks, each with its own charge transport behavior, in Nature Chemistry.

original_title: Defect-Rich Fe3+-Substituted RuO2: A Novel Rutile Phase Setting a New Benchmark in Alkaline Water Oxidation
title: A rutile RuO2 that barely budges after 1000 hours of OER
blurb: An Fe3+-substituted RuO2 rutile phase (Ru0.63Fe0.37O2-x), made via a low-temperature single-source precursor route and loaded with oxygen vacancies and cation mixing at 2-5 nm particle size. It runs alkaline oxygen evolution at 86 mV overpotential at 100 mA/cm2 and holds past 200 mA/cm2 for 1000 hours without visible degradation, a genuinely strong number if it survives outside this lab.

original_title: Cellular uptake of folate-olaparib conjugates via folate receptor-mediated endocytosis: Potential for selective delivery of DNA damage response inhibitors into tumour cells
title: Sneaking olaparib into tumor cells through the folate receptor
blurb: The pitch: fuse olaparib to folate, let folate receptors overexpressed on ovarian tumor cells pull the conjugate in by endocytosis, and get selective DDRi delivery that widens the drug's therapeutic window for combination with DNA-damaging chemo. This is still the stage of showing FR-mediated uptake works at all, not proof it beats the free drug.

original_title: Novartis (SWX:NOVN) Lands Global Radioligand Therapy License To Deepen Cancer Pipeline - Yahoo Finance
title: Novartis buys its way further into radioligand therapy
blurb: Novartis picked up a global license for a radioligand therapy to bulk out its cancer pipeline. Standard pipeline shopping, no data attached.

original_title: Collision‐programmed Selectivity in CO 2 Electrochemical Reduction via Co‐engineering Electron Transfer Duty Cycle and Proton Transport
title: Letting catalyst particles bump the electrode instead of sitting on it
blurb: Rather than fixing a catalyst film to the electrode at constant potential, this suspends free catalyst particles that make brief, random contacts with it, which lets the electron-transfer duty cycle and proton transport be tuned together instead of being stuck with whatever the fixed film gives you. Pitched as a genuinely different platform for CO2 reduction selectivity, not another catalyst tweak.

original_title: Electrochemical Platform for Automated Design-of-Experiment Optimization of Ni-Catalyzed Cross-Electrophile Coupling Reactions
title: Robots doing the grunt work of scaling up electrosynthesis
blurb: An automated platform bolts a commercial synthesis workstation, peristaltic pumps, and a potentiostat together to run batch experiments and dial in stir rate, temperature, and the rest of the variables that decide whether a nice small-scale Ni-catalyzed cross-electrophile coupling survives being scaled up. More infrastructure than chemistry, but scaling electrosynthesis, not the reactions themselves, has been the actual bottleneck.

original_title: Redox-Triggered Proton Transfer in Synthetic Models for Non-Heme Diiron Enzymes: Spectroscopic, Computational, and Mechanistic Insights
title: Watching a synthetic model catch the proton transfer diiron enzymes hide
blurb: Non-heme diiron enzymes couple electron transfer to proton transfer during catalysis, but the real active sites hide it, the intermediates move too fast to isolate. A synthetic model system stands in instead, and spectroscopy plus computation tie a redox event to a proton transfer step to map how the high-valent iron-oxido/hydroxido intermediate actually forms.

original_title: Development of Enterovirus D68 3C Protease Inhibitors with In Vivo Efficacy in a Neurological Infection Model
title: An antiviral candidate for the virus tied to childhood paralysis outbreaks
blurb: EV-D68 causes acute flaccid myelitis in kids and has no approved vaccine or antiviral. Structure-guided design of dipeptidyl 3C protease inhibitors, plus a prodrug tweak, lands on Jun13133, which is potent and selective against current EV-D68 isolates and EV-A71 and actually works in an in vivo neurological infection model, not just in a dish.

original_title: First-in-Class Bispecific ADC Shows Activity in Relapsed Extensive-Stage Small Cell Lung Cancer - ascopost.com
title: A bispecific ADC shows up in relapsed small cell lung cancer
blurb: First-in-class bispecific antibody-drug conjugate reported with activity in relapsed extensive-stage small cell lung cancer, a disease that badly needs more options. That it worked is about all there is to go on so far.

original_title: Photothermal Aerobic Oxidation of Benzylic C–H Bonds by NHPI/PINO Catalysis
title: Turning benzylic C-H bonds into ketones with light and carbon black
blurb: Carbon black soaks up visible light and turns it to heat, which drives NHPI/PINO-catalyzed aerobic oxidation of benzylic C(sp3)-H bonds straight to benzyl ketones under air. A cheap swap of a photoreactor headache for a lightbulb and some soot.

original_title: A Unified Theory for Generalized Step-Growth Polymerization: From Flory’s Equal‑Reactivity to Kinetic Symmetry‑Breaking
title: The step-growth polymer math that's been wrong for 90 years
blurb: Flory's equal-reactivity assumption has run step-growth polymerization statistics since the 1930s, but rigid fused-ring monomers and catalytic bond-forming mechanisms break it, and the resulting molecular-weight anomalies have usually gotten blamed on side reactions or impurities instead. This reworks the AA + BB polycondensation math into a framework built around kinetic symmetry-breaking. A theory paper, so no new molecule, just years of misread data waiting for a second look.

original_title: Oxygen‐Tolerant, Controlled Synthesis of Degradable and Water‐Soluble Poly(Vinyl Amide)s via Radical Ring‐Opening Copolymerization of Cyclic Dithiothreitol
title: Degradable vinyl polymers made without babysitting the oxygen
blurb: PET-RAFT copolymerization of cyclic dithiothreitol with a broad range of N-vinyl monomers, and some less reactive ones too, builds degradable linkages right into the vinyl backbone, and it tolerates open air instead of demanding a glovebox. Comes out with predictable molecular weights and low dispersity, so the tolerance isn't costing control.

original_title: Self-induced charge transfer activation enables metal-free C–H coupling of polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons under photo irradiation
title: Nanographenes get their chirality without a metal catalyst in sight
blurb: A Bronsted acid and O2 under light couple two arenol C-H bonds directly, no metal catalyst, talking itself into the reaction via a self-induced charge transfer complex. The product is axially chiral 3D nanographene, and it dodges overoxidation, the usual failure mode when you push arenols this hard.

original_title: SpectrSeqTools: LC-MS/MS-Based De Novo Sequencing of Small Ribonucleic Acids with Post-Transcriptional Modifications
title: A mass-spec tool for reading RNA modifications sequencing can't see
blurb: Sequencing only catches a fraction of RNA's post-transcriptional modifications, and existing mass spec tools for nucleic acids are notoriously limited in what they can call. SpectrSeqTools does de novo sequencing of small RNAs straight from LC-MS/MS data, modifications included, in their actual sequence context rather than just flagging that something's off.

original_title: Multistate Alkoxyamine-Based Securinega Alkaloid/Azobenzene Hybrid Photoswitch with Time-Dependent Controllability
title: A photoswitch with more than two settings
blurb: Most molecular photoswitches are stuck on binary on/off logic. This one links a phyllantidine framework, a securinega alkaloid, to a dimethylaminoazobenzene through an alkoxyamine, and the two photoswitching systems respond on different timescales, giving several addressable states instead of just two. Pitched at denser data encoding and logic, though that's still a pitch more than a working device.

original_title: Direct generation of a prototypical n-pentyl peroxy radical reveals how mixedfate chemical regimes shape product distributions
title: Forcing a peroxy radical into the reaction channels chambers usually starve out
blurb: Atmospheric RO2 radicals can react with NO, with HO2, with each other, or isomerize, but standard chamber setups mostly just hand you the NO channel. Here they generate n-pentyl peroxy radical directly from 1-iodopentane photolysis and dial into the messier mixed-fate regimes, where self-reaction and isomerization actually compete. The product distributions shift in ways the NO-dominated experiments never would have shown.
